items.title: Global Payments falls 9% as CD&R, GTCR abandon takeover talks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Global Payments shares fell 9% on Thursday and were halted under a volatility breaker after private equity firms Clayton, Dubilier & Rice (CD&R) and GTCR abandoned discussions about a potential acquisition of the payments processor, Reuters reported, citing two people familiar with the matter.
